collection.description: A child thinks their shadow is trying to catch them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) thinks their shadow is trying to catch them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) sees that a body blocks sunlight.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) notices two shadows under two lights.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) tells a tale about loyal shadows as fiction.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks which parts are real and which are imagined.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) records a long morning shadow and a short midday one.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Clouds interrupt the experiment, teaching patience.
